note: Off I-70 exit 28 at 774 23 Rd, Grand Junction, on the north side of the interstate. Views of Colorado National Monument, Grand Mesa and the Bookcliffs. Its only web page is a Colorado Vacation Directory listing (undated): RV sites $40-60 a night for two, monthly $750 plus metered electric. Tent-camper reviews (2023-24) describe the tent area at the back beside a scrapyard and abandoned campers. --Claude
summary: The stored website is a parked domain; the park's only web presence is its Colorado Vacation Directory listing (Google Maps links it) and a Google listing (3.7 / 106 reviews). Confirmed from the listing (as reported): 27 full-hookup pull-throughs, 13 at 50 amp and 45+ ft, laundry/showers; added year-round and phone booking. No dated operator rate, so fees stay empty. Note: dropped the hookup/count/amenity restatements.
flags: Dead website: https://moondancervcampgroundcolorado.com/ redirects to a parked-domain page (ww17.). No operator site exists; Google Maps gives http://www.coloradodirectory.com/moondancervcamp/ as the website. Suggest that, or clear the website.
Phone: stored 970-270-3966; the directory listing and Google Maps both give (970) 245-0769. Suggest 970-245-0769.
Name: Google Maps and the directory call it 'Moondance RV and Campground'.

Price: no 2024+ dated rate anywhere. The undated directory listing says RV sites $40-60 a night for two; Campendium shows a last rate of $35. Price indicator is only the RV Life $$ tier. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Arches NP 102 km), so a rate over US$50 would fail the gate; the family has not stayed here. Presence passes on Google Maps (open, 106 reviews, phone).

Possible long-stay character: the listing advertises monthly RV sites ($750 on-season plus metered electric) beside the nightly rate; a 2023 Google review mentions 'a bunch of abandoned campers' by the tent area and another calls the owner 'a slum lord'. Not enough to judge the five tests from outside; a nightly rate is posted (undated).
